verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so GPU-vendor acceleration is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows NVIDIA, AMD or other vendor-specific kernels. Its own docs say local use needs 'no GPU' and models run without a GPU. Community reports say Needle 3 doesn't run inference on Apple GPU and the GPU goes unused on a Pixel even when enabled. Hosted GPUs are mentioned only for platform training.
